title: BOJ holds rates as underlying inflation aligns with 2% target for first time since 2013
summary_full: The BOJ declared that its underlying inflation target of 2% has been met, the first time the central bank has done so since it set the target in 2013.
summary_public: The BOJ declared that its underlying inflation target of 2% has been met, the first time the central bank has done so since it set the target in 2013.
